steps.name: Remove committed cert.p12 and add to .gitignore
steps.description: Remove the cert.p12 from the repo and add *.p12 to .gitignore for security.

steps.name: Remove dead code: showAutoModeDisabledNotice and updateModeStatus
steps.description: Remove the empty showAutoModeDisabledNotice method from MenuBarController and the empty updateModeStatus method from SettingsViewController, along with their call sites.

steps.name: Deduplicate readProperty by removing readPropertyDouble extension
steps.description: Enhance the generic IOKitBridging.readProperty to handle NSNumber→Double coercion, then remove the readPropertyDouble extension from ALSReader.swift.

steps.name: Deduplicate formatLux / LuxLevel.displayValue
steps.description: Create a shared LuxFormatter utility and have both SettingsViewController and LuxLevel.displayValue use it.

steps.name: Cache resolved function pointers in PrivateAPILoader
steps.description: Convert the dlsym-based accessor methods to use static lazy cached closures to avoid repeated dlsym calls.

steps.name: Cache StatusBarIcon image
steps.description: Cache the loaded lumen icon in StatusBarIcon to avoid repeated bundle searching on every updateIcon call.

steps.name: Remove @Observable from ThresholdEngine
steps.description: Remove the @Observable macro and Observation import from ThresholdEngine since it's never observed via SwiftUI.

steps.name: Clean up root-level debug scripts
steps.description: Move check_lumen_windows.swift, find_lumen.sh, list_windows.swift, and test_status_items.sh into the scripts/ directory.

steps.name: Extract ManualOverrideDetector from MainAppController
steps.description: Extract lastSelfTriggeredSwitchTime and the time-window check into a separate ManualOverrideDetector class.

steps.name: Skip cached source in ALSReader fallback loop
steps.description: In ALSReader.currentReading(), skip the already-failed cached source in the fallback loop.

steps.name: Add clarifying comments for ALS property fallbacks and didSet-during-init
steps.description: Add comments explaining the two IORegistry property fallbacks and the didSet-during-init behavior in SettingsStore.

steps.name: Clean up unused LuxLevel conformances
steps.description: Add a comment explaining LuxLevel's purpose and remove Identifiable if unused. Add comment to DebounceTimerProtocol about testability.

steps.name: Build and verify all changes compile
steps.description: Run the build to ensure all changes compile correctly with no errors.
